story: On the rooftop, the Casinos ran hot and clean through Fender amps pushed to the very edge of breakup — warm, dynamic, and honest, with the pick attack doing the work. We approximate that with the FENDER_BLACKFACE voicing: high headroom, gently scooped mids, and only a whisper of soft clip when you dig in. Listen for how the chords bloom and compress slightly on the hardest strums rather than distorting.
